meta.units: stripped values in hbar/(16 pi^2); colour word ad_{Y_r}..ad_{Y_1}; on a colour-singlet bilinear with two outputs the stripped value is the coefficient in units u = hbar tr_g(ad ad)/(16 pi^2 (,)) = -g^2 N/(32 pi^2); planar adjacent pair: (-1)^r value/2 units
meta.basis: (1, log2, log3, log5, log7) with Q[i] coefficients

composite_line.statement: L(k) S h_T1+..+T4(-k,k) S L(k)/2 (engine normalisation, numerators of P(eps,infty) with e^{-eps k^2}/k^2 each): components c x lam = -|k|^2 xi, lam x c = +|k|^2 xi; one orientation gives -+ xi e^{-2 eps |k|^2}/|k|^2 (-,-)^{-1}, and the composite line 2(P* xi. P* (x) 1)K_0 (both orientations) is -+ 2 xi e^{-2 eps |k|^2}/|k|^2 (-,-)^{-1}, negative on c (x) lam: real, as route B (the factor +-2i guessed in Rem qs-twocomp was wrong)

E0.sign_rule: per configuration, on top of the raw chain T = L_1 S h_1 ... L_n S h_n S L_0 S and the intrinsic pair sign (-1)^{|X_a|+|X_b|}: (-1)^{n(<sigma) + |S1(x)|(n(<s) + [s<sigma])} (-1)^{[sigma = L_0]}, GLOBAL = +1 (Def qs-defect (ii); the factor (-1)^{[sigma=L_0]} removes the sign that S L_0 S produces on a special line at X_b). Fixed by: line placement = Part-C engine exactly (E0-partC), G-reg (bosonic and fermionic, pair by pair), GS, G-R1.
E0.canonical_form: alpha delta + beta^mu d_mu delta + gamma^{mu nu} d_mu d_nu delta <-> K_0 = alpha, K_mu = i beta^mu, K_munu = -gamma^munu (Prop qs-K (i)); route A computes the intrinsic parts with z^mu -> -i d/dr_mu, z^mu z^nu -> -d^2/dr_mu dr_nu (exact Lagrange interpolation in r)
E0.twisted_coefficient: Q^xi_1 = L_1^(0) + Q_1 - (1/2) L_1^(2)(xi,xi) (Def c8-twisted); arity-two kernels not computed here

TQ4.classical: {S^(1)(xi), O} = +F1 (Cor c7-Q; Lemma qs-arrows with the corrected sign: A -> +Gamma(xi,lam)); revision 2026-10-30, finding Q2

c_Q.statement: Q_1(O)|_traceless = c_Q {S^(1)(xi),O},  c_Q = 2*log2 + -2*log3 - theta_perp - p_perp  (units u); p_perp the perp coefficient of the particular solution of eq qs-arity1xi (TQ1, not computed)

scheme_family.G_B (outer, a): -a along S_+ (x) W, +a along S_- (x) W^*
scheme_family.field countings y_f: the arrow A_perp -> lam of the classical transformation is multiplied by the difference of the countings (Prop qs-laws (a)): c_Q -> c_Q +- (y_lam - y_A)

trace_part.remark: psi = 0 (L_1^(0) != 0 on the family): a2 = a3. One-body terms contribute to F1 only. The cocycle representative (psi with L_1^(0) = 0 on {O, F1}) is in TQ4.cocycle_scheme (stage G-R1).

cocycle_scheme.psi(O): -1 + 2*log2 + -2*log3 u (w1,w2) int omega (A_V, A_V)  [L_1^(0)(O) = 2 kappa u (w1,w2) int omega (dc, A_V) at psi = 0, removed]
cocycle_scheme.psi(F1): -2 u F3  (two-field sector of L_1^(0)(F1) removed)
cocycle_scheme.change of Q_1(O): [{S^(1)(xi),-}, psi](O) = 2 kappa F3 - kappa' F3  (Prop c8-laws (b))
cocycle_scheme.statement: in a scheme with L_1^(0) = 0 on {O, F1} the two-body part of Q_1 on the trace bilinear is a1 F1 + a2 F2: the gauge-variant term drops out (a3 = 0), as required by s Q_1(O) = 0 (R1); a1, a2, a4 and the traceless part are unchanged

G-R1.bookkeeping: odd-odd outputs (c, lam) antisymmetrised, even-odd (c, A_V) symmetrised; {S^(1)(xi),O} = +F1; {S^(1)(xi),-} odd derivation, A_V -> +Gamma(xi,lam)|_V (qa_r1.py docstring)

bilinears.reading: Upsilon^0_Delta = 40/3 O (traceless) and 40/3 - 48 = -104/3 per unit trace bilinear; with the position part 2 x^mu (-1/3) d_mu O this is the first row of Thm c9-D1: 44/3 O - 1/3 {S^(1)(Delta),O} (traceless), -100/3 O - 1/3 {S^(1)(Delta),O} (trace); Upsilon_{P_b} = -1/3 d_b O (Thm c9-P1)

TQ5.eta_chirality: S_+ (x) W^* (generators S^alpha_i); xi_mu = rho(e_mu) eta in S_- (x) W^*
TQ5.position_part: graph by graph the xi-kernel at rho(b) eta (built so; G-pos)
TQ5.S_1_on_bilinears: S_1(O) = Q_1 along the Killing spinor rho(x_O) eta (position part, coefficients of TQ4 along S_- (x) W^*) + Upsilon^0_eta, whose only leg set on (A_perp, A_perp) is a single lam, which vanishes on the colour-singlet bilinear; the one-body s0 direction does not act on A_perp letters. Hence Upsilon^0_eta = 0 on O (Cor c7-S).
TQ5.S_1_on_descendants: Upsilon^0_eta(A_perp, lam_+) on the leg set A_perp A_perp (rows above) gives the intrinsic part of S_1 on the weight-5/2 descendants

TQ6.K_1_on_bilinears: Upsilon^0_K(A_perp,A_perp) has the leg sets (none) and A_V only (weight 1): zero on the colour-singlet bilinear, so K_1(O) = v(x)^mu P_1(O)|_{e_mu} - (b,x) D^0_1(O) + M^0_1(O) by eq qs-K1dec (G-KD with P_1 ~ 0, M^0_1 = 0 by covariance on scalars)
TQ6.T_independence: route A evaluates the T-independent eps -> 0 coefficients of Thm qs-simplex (iii), (iv) directly; the log T term (3/8 pi^2) hbar x zero-mode tree is not part of K_1 (Prop qs-K (ii)) and is not computed by route A

TQ3.exact_contraction: qa_core.contract_exact (revision, finding Q1); contractions with non-Gaussian-integer letters in this stage: 29160 of 32020
TQ3.reduction: only modulo Im Q^xi_0 (finding Q6): the exact directions (none occur) and the derivative on a dc output, the holomorphic Dirac component d^alphadot lambdabar_{alphadot 4}, are dropped; total derivatives are kept (they are nonzero local operators); class-level comparison with [BK] not done
TQ3.Konishi_entry_c_K: 0 at psi = 0 (two-body kernel (lam_+, A_perp) -> lam_- lam_- vanishes identically for every xi; no one-body term reaches lam_- lam_-); scheme dependent (Prop qs-laws (b))

TQ2.orderings: n=0: all orderings (<= 6); n=1: 2; n=2, 3: 1 per leg set
TQ2.finite_special_vertices: not included; they can enter rows with D >= 2 only (D_F = D_ct + 2m)
TQ2.census_crosscheck: nonzero configurations per ordering <= census chains (both orderings): False

two_component.orientation: dictionary orientation (S_+ = undotted for dx^1 dx^2 dx^3 dx^4); engine A labels mirrored, numbers identical by the reflection symmetry
two_component.O: int omega (iota_w1 A, iota_w2 A) = 1/16 int omega (w1^{ij} A_ij, w2^{kl} A_kl)
two_component.F1: int omega [(iota_w1 A, (rho(w2) xi, lam)) + (1<->2)] = 1/4 int omega [(w1^{kl} A_kl, w2_{ji} xi^{alpha i} lam_alpha^j) + (1<->2)]
two_component.F2: (w1,w2) int omega (rho(A|_perp) xi, lam) = 1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij int omega (A_{ji}, xi^{alpha i} lam_alpha^j)
two_component.F3: (w1,w2) int omega (rho(A|_V) xi, lam) = 1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij int omega i (lambdabar_{alphadot i}, A_m sigmabar^{m alphadot alpha} xi_alpha^i)
two_component.F4: (w1,w2) int omega (c, (xi, lam^*)) = 1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij int omega (c, xi_alpha^i lam^{*alpha}_i)
two_component.classical: {S^(1)(xi), O} = +F1  (A_ij -> +Gamma(xi,lam)_ij, Gamma_kl(xi, lam) = -2 eps_{jikl} (xi^j lam^i), dictionary entry Gamma; Cor c7-Q)
two_component.Q1_two_body_psi0: Q_1(O)|_two-body = (2*log2 + -2*log3) F1 + (-4*log2 + 4*log3) F2 + (-4*log2 + 4*log3) F3 + (0) F4  units u = -g^2 N/(32 pi^2)  (psi = 0)
two_component.c_Q: Q_1(O)|_traceless = c_Q {S^(1)(xi), O},  c_Q = 2*log2 + -2*log3 - theta_perp - p_perp
two_component.trace_psi0: Q_1(O)|_trace, two-body (psi = 0) = (-4*log2 + 4*log3) (1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij) int omega [(A_ji, xi^{alpha i} lam_alpha^j) + i (lambdabar_{alphadot i}, A_m sigmabar^{m alphadot alpha} xi_alpha^i)]

two_component.bc_lamstar: Q_1( int omega (c, u_alpha lam^{*alpha}_4) ) on lambdabar_{alphadot 4} lambdabar^{alphadot}_4: 0
two_component.betabeta: Q_1( int omega (u'^alpha lam_alpha^I, u'^beta lam_beta^J) ) on (lambdabar_{alphadot 4}, d^{alphadot} A_{K4}), K the complement of I, J: nonzero, holomorphic derivatives d_alphadot = u'^alpha sigma^m_{alpha alphadot} d_m only, the same coefficient for both colour orders (per unit weight-vector letters 2/3 on d^{alphadot} gamma^K lambdabar_{alphadot 4}, modulo the Q^xi_0-exact Dirac component)
two_component.bgamma: Q_1( int omega (u'^alpha F_mn (sigma^m sigmabar^n)_alpha^beta u'_beta, A_{I4}) ) on (lambdabar_{alphadot 4}, d^{alphadot} A_{I4}): nonzero, holomorphic derivatives only; modulo Im Q^xi_0 the two colour orders have unequal coefficients containing log(3/2) (engine weight-vector normalisation 64/3 - 128 log(3/2) and 32 + 64 log(3/2)); no reduction modulo total derivatives
two_component.eta_killing: eps_alpha^i(x) = -i x_m sigma^m_{alpha alphadot} etabar^{alphadot i},  epsbar_{alphadot i}(x) = i x_m eta^alpha_i sigma^m_{alpha alphadot}; intrinsic vertex s0 = (A^{kj} eps_{alpha beta} eta^beta_j, lam^{*alpha}_k) - (A_kj eps_{betadot alphadot} etabar^{alphadot j}, lambdabar^{*betadot k})
two_component.K_b: v^m = x^2 b^m - 2 (b.x) x^m; intrinsic z-polynomial vertex of Rem qs-twocomp with z = x - x_O
two_component.cocycle_scheme: psi(O) = (-1 + 2*log2 + -2*log3) u 1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij int omega (A_m, A_m), psi(F1) = (-2) u F3; then Q_1(O)|_two-body = (2*log2 + -2*log3) F1 + (-4*log2 + 4*log3) F2: the term i (lambdabar_{alphadot i}, A_m sigmabar^{m alphadot alpha} xi_alpha^i) drops out
